About

A voice for people & peace

I am Abdul Salam Mohamed Aroos from Oddamavadi, Batticaloa. I work every day on youth empowerment, human rights and community welfare, and I stand beside people who need support.

From youth coordination in the Eastern Province to international human rights work and the 2024 Parliamentary Election, my path has been about one thing: serving the community.

I completed leadership training with the Central Community Center, Oddamavadi and studies at the American College of Computing & Informative Studies.
